text:
zoe: Tiny holiday plan 1) ugly scarf swap at HQ + virtual playlist share 2) bring a scarf (or a photo) and a song suggestion for the 'Tinsel Tunes' playlist? :scarf: :musical_note:
ryan: love it. can we do a tiny prize for 'most aggressively festive' scarf? :trophy: i'll donate a mystery candy box.
meera: i'll be remote but will post a scarf pic. also can we vote with emoji? :heart: = best scarf, :star: = best song rec, :laughing: = most chaotic.
julian: count me in. will bring a ridiculous knitted monstrosity. also happy to curate the playlist 10-15 songs. i'll drop a link once it's up.
zoe: quick poll so people can pick day: /poll "When for scarf swap + playlist reveal?" "Wed 4pm" "Thu 4pm" "Fri 4pm"
ops-bot: Poll closed. Winner: Thu 4pm. Event reminder set for Thu 15:45 local.
lina: Logistics Q: can someone leave a small table by reception for scarf drop? i'll coordinate with facilities.
ryan: i'll pin a note and drop extra tags for names. will also label the prize. :label:; julian: playlist draft link: https://tiny.redwood/tinsel-tunes (open for edits) 
meera: uploaded scarf pic. caption: 'handmade by my nosy aunt' :sweater: (not shown)
zoe: Reminder: Thu 15:45 we'll do a 10-minute virtual reveal and then 5 minutes of reactions for winners. please upload photos to #random before 15:30 if you want them in the slideshow.
ops-bot: Event ended: photos received 11. Winners by reactions: most festive scarf = julian, best song rec = meera ("Winterdrive"), most chaotic = ryan. Prize: mystery candy box to julian. Congrats! :tada:
